name: Efficient Space Skipping & Adaptive Sampling of Unstructured Volumes Using H.W. Accel. Ray Tracing
aliases: Space Skipping and Adaptive Sampling for Unstructured Volumes
definition: A method for interactive visualization of large unstructured volumes (e.g., from finite element simulations) that leverages hardware-accelerated ray tracing to accelerate acceleration structure traversal and point-in-element tests, while reducing the number of samples taken along each ray via empty space skipping and adaptive sampling.
